project_name: BRQ | Saudi Police Mod - FiveM Roleplay
app_archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Command Hub (Tactical Police RP)

entry_surfaces./: split tactical hero — cinematic flashing emergency cruiser canvas + prestige gold & Saudi green badge left, instant server HUD & direct join CTAs right
entry_surfaces./quiz: tactical CAD test terminal — interactive acceptance qualification quiz with timed scenario cards and instant pass/fail score telemetry
entry_surfaces./apply: classified recruitment terminal — multi-step Saudi Police academy & patrol divisions registration form with real-time field validation
entry_surfaces./rules: numbered tactical protocol manifesto — collapsible chapters covering patrol rules, ROE (rules of engagement), radio codes, and disciplinary matrix
entry_surfaces./news: police dispatch intelligence feed — tactical bulletin cards, operation reports, update logs with search and division tags
entry_surfaces./admin: command & control dashboard — tactical admin panel for managing applications, candidate status triage, news dispatch authoring, and server telemetry

layout_and_grids.bento_mode: Tetris Mode A for visual feature highlights + High Density Mode B for CAD/Admin analytics and server telemetry
layout_and_grids.header_spec: Fixed z-50 top-0 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#060A0E]/90 border-b border-[#1E2D42]/80 h-20 px-4 lg:px-8 flex items-center justify-between rtl
layout_and_grids.hero_composition: Full-bleed atmospheric dark tactical backdrop with pulse amber/blue siren lights, left-to-right visual weight for RTL: Title with glowing green/gold badges, live server status pill (128/128 Online, 24ms ping), primary Action Buttons ('دخول السيرفر المباشر - F8 connect play.brq-sa.com' and 'انضم لـ Discord BRQ'), quick copy IP button with toast, and interactive mini-stats preview.

tactical_hud_elements: Subtle top-right HUD coordinates tag e.g. [SECTOR: RIYADH-01 // FREQ: 144.200 MHz]
Gold and Saudi Green 1px illuminated corner brackets on cards
Emergency light bar subtle dual glow: pulsing red on left flank, pulsing blue on right flank in header/hero atmosphere
Tactical scanline or noise texture overlay (opacity-3) across command cards
Interactive copy-to-clipboard server connection string with audible/visual click confirmation toast

motion_and_animations.hero_reveal: Staggered fade up with y-offset of 20px, duration 0.6s easeOut
motion_and_animations.emergency_beacon_glow: CSS keyframe pulse between 0.3 and 0.8 opacity for tactical blue/red edge beacons
motion_and_animations.cards_hover: Transform translateY -4px, shadow 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 158, 73, 0.15) with border-color transitioning to gold/emerald
motion_and_animations.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential motion in accessibility guard

accessibility_and_rtl.contrast_check: All text tokens exceed 4.5:1 against respective surfaces (#F8FAFC on #060A0E gives > 18:1 ratio)
accessibility_and_rtl.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, tabs, filter pills, quiz options, and admin actions must carry explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure RTL is set on the root element and Arabic typography is primary (dir='rtl' lang='ar' on html/body)

Implement the dark Saudi Police tactical aesthetic: deep obsidian backgrounds (#060A0E, #0D141D), Saudi Green accents (#009E49), Prestige Gold borders/highlights (#D4AF37), and tactical navy accents (#0B192C, #1E40AF)

The Hero section must feature the tactical police night background image with high-contrast copy, live server status card (118/128 players), instant connect button that copies 'connect play.brq-sa.com' with Sonner toast, and direct Discord button
Create the interactive 5-question Acceptance Quiz (إلكتروني اختبار) with radio codes and police scenarios, showing instant scoring and qualification certificate badge upon passing (>=80%)
Build the Recruitment Application Form (التقديم) which saves to MongoDB via /api/applications with validation for discord tag, age, division, and scenario analysis
Build the Tactical Rules Section (القوانين) categorized into: General Server Rules, Patrol & Engagement Protocol, Radio & 10-Codes, Disciplinary Matrix
Build the Dispatch News Feed (الأخبار) connected to /api/news with category filtering and read modals
Build the Simple Admin Dashboard (/admin) allowing admins to login (demo credentials: admin / brq2026), review applications (approve/reject with notes), and manage news posts
Include sound/visual feedback on interactive elements (emergency beacons, radar sweep animations, copy confirmation toasts)
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing subagent verification
